items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority (social-law letter under SGB X). Per the letter's own clause ('Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben') and §37 Abs. 2 SGB X, the Bescheid counts as bekanntgegeben on the 4th day after posting = Tue 24.11.2026 (also today). Per §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event (24.11.) is not counted; the one-month period (§188 Abs.2 BGB) then runs from 25.11.2026 and ends on the day of the last month whose number corresponds to the starting event day, i.e. Thu 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and a normal business day in NW (Heiligabend is not a statutory public holiday), so no weekend/holiday shift applies (§26 Abs.3 SGB X).

warnings: The letter mentions that Bildung-und-Teilhabe benefits require a separate application to be filed with the person's Kommune ('den Antrag dafür stellen Sie bei Ihrer Kommune'), but gives no deadline for that application — worth checking directly with the Kommune so no entitlement is lost.

The IBAN printed (DE76 5000 0000 0004 5901 00) is structurally valid, but this letter is an approval notice with no payment request to the recipient, so there is no reason to use that IBAN for anything; treat any later message asking you to pay or confirm via that account with suspicion.
